delivery.variance: No scored outcome variance within either arm. Control command details vary: direct gh merge in reps 1/2/5; conditional future merge in 3/4. Candidates converge on retained state plus Native Task question and wait. Deadline alone did not induce premature closure in any control.

composition.variance: One fresh sample per case/variant; case differences are not a within-case variance estimate.

supplemental_K2.interpretation: Approved executable-stage response includes correct preflight/fetch/ff-only/worktree ordering. Original K strict failure remains; K2 does not erase it or establish repeated reliability.

uncertainty: Five delivery repetitions provide limited evidence on one inherited model and one prompt, not a production reliability estimate.
Candidate I/J actual reads are actor-reported; final-response archives lack complete tool transcript exports.
J candidate promises to establish baseline scenarios before edits without spelling a persistent eval directory; scored pass on the requested behavior, with this specificity limitation.
K failure is an omission after an approval wait, not demonstrated base mutation or reversed ordering. K2 narrows this uncertainty at the executable stage.
No real GitHub task, monitor lifecycle, image build, or generated packaging exercised.
